context: Mei and Aoi catch up after a while.
purpose: Casual register; vocabulary (久々/そのうち/コレクション/損/どころ) in natural home.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 久々に、ゆっくり会えて嬉しいな。
lines.en: I'm glad to relax together after a while.
lines.style: soft warm woman voice, gentle delighted delivery throughout

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 私も!そのうち、旅行も行きたいね。
lines.en: Me too! Eventually let's travel too.
lines.style: bright barista voice, soft warm cheerful delivery throughout

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 最近、雑貨のコレクション始めたの。
lines.en: Lately I started a knick-knack collection.
lines.style: gentle woman voice, soft warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: いいね、お金は損しない?
lines.style: curious barista voice, soft warm cheerful delivery throughout

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 損どころか、心が豊かになるの。
lines.en: Far from a loss, it enriches my heart.
lines.style: soft woman voice, gentle warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: そのうち、コレクション見せてよ。
lines.style: cheerful barista voice, soft warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: もちろん!久々に、わくわくしてるの。
lines.en: Of course! I'm excited for the first time in a while.
lines.style: gentle woman voice, soft warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: そのうち、私も始めようかな!
lines.en: Maybe I'll start one eventually too!
lines.style: bubbly barista voice, soft warm cheerful closing delivery throughout
